subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blanks.

Soon after the doctor gave her the next ________ of the medicine, the patient began to ________.
solution:
The correct option is: **dose, doze**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Dose"** refers to a measured amount of medicine. (खुराक)
 
• **"To doze" **means to fall into a light sleep. 
 
• **"Dose" (noun) **refers to a measured amount of medicine, and** "doze" (verb) **means to fall into a light sleep.
 
• The sentence indicates that the patient began to fall into a light sleep after receiving a measured amount of medicine.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**option 3**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1 **"dose, dozed"** uses "dozed" incorrectly as it implies a past action, whereas the sentence requires a present tense verb.
 
• Option 2 **"dosed, doze" **is incorrect because "dosed" is not a noun and does not fit in the first blank which requires a noun.
 
• Option 4 **"doze, dose" **reverses the correct order of the words; the noun "dose" should come first, followed by the verb "doze."
